video.title: How This "AI BUILT" Web App Makes $26k/Month!

summary: Niche Pursuits presents FormulaBot.com, an Excel add-on chatbot built by non-programmer David Brestler on Bubble.io, reportedly making about $26,000/month. The host then builds his own simple AI side-hustle idea generator live in about 45 minutes with Hostinger Horizons (the video's sponsor) and shows the iterative prompting. He closes with David's marketing path: personal network, Reddit, Google ads, SEO, podcasts and YouTube. Key takeaway: AI/no-code tools make building an MVP easy, but distribution is what produces revenue.

tactics.name: Launch in communities where your target users gather
steps: Tell coworkers and personal contacts first
Post the tool in the relevant Reddit community
Add Google ads and SEO afterwards
Keep appearing on podcasts, YouTube and social media

quote.text: you need to go where your community congregates and tell as many people as possible
quote.speaker: Host

tactics.name: Iterative prompting with an AI app builder
steps: Write a first prompt describing headline, input box, outputs and button
Review output and chat to fix generic results
Ask for expandable details: description, steps, realistic revenue
Optionally connect the OpenAI API for better output

tactics.name: Build a tool to solve a problem you get repeatedly asked about
steps: Notice questions colleagues keep asking you
Build a chatbot-style tool for it in evenings alongside a job
Test willingness to pay with a freemium plan

lessons.lesson: Domain expertise plus no-code AI tools can produce an MVP without programming skills.
Solving a problem you are repeatedly asked about is a good validation signal.
Start by sharing with your personal network, then scale to communities like Reddit, then paid ads and SEO.
Build while keeping a full-time job; the founder worked evenings.
Free tools can still make money through other routes, per the host's teaser of a free-tool site.

evidence_quality.rationale: Revenue figure is second-hand from an interview and unverified; no cost or churn data. The host's own build is a demo with no revenue. Whisper-tiny transcript has mis-heard words.
evidence_quality.promotional_conflict: Hostinger Horizons is the video sponsor with a discount code; the host also promotes his own channel and Niche Pursuits.
